name: deploy_version
label: Release Version Table
description: The version table is used for reporting scenarios such as time dimension statistics and query associations related to release times.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: is_freeze
fields.description: Indicates whether the version is frozen. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: fcd
fields.description: Creation time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: line_add_count
fields.description: Increase the number of code lines.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: id_is_locked
indexes.description: Standard index covering the is_freeze field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_fcd
indexes.description: Standard index covering the fcd field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_app_system_id_app_module_id_version
indexes.description: Unique index covering the version, app_system_id, app_module_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
